title: Preface to 'How the other half thinks: Adventures in mathematical reasoning'

sentences.en: A. Occasionally, in some difficult musical compositions, there are beautiful, but easy parts -parts so simple a beginner could play them.
sentences.zh: A. 有时,在一些困难的音乐作品中,会有美丽但简单的部分——这些部分简单到初学者都可以演奏。

sentences.en: So it is with mathematics as well.

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: There are some discoveries in advanced mathematics that do not depend on specialized knowledge, not even on algebra, geometry, or trigonometry.
sentences.zh: 高等数学中的一些发现并不依赖于专业知识,甚至不依赖于代数、几何或三角学。

sentences.en: Instead, they may involve, at most, a little arithmetic, such as 'the sum of two odd numbers is even', and common sense.
sentences.zh: 相反,它们最多可能涉及一点算术,例如“两个奇数之和是偶数”和常识。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Each of the eight chapters in this book illustrates this phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 本书的八章每一章都说明了这一现象。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Anyone can understand every step in the reasoning.
sentences.zh: 任何人都可以理解推理中的每一步。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The thinking in each chapter uses at most only elementary arithmetic, and sometimes not even that.
sentences.zh: 每一章的思维最多只使用初等算术,有时甚至不使用初等算术。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Thus all readers will have the chance to participate in a mathematical experience, to appreciate the beauty of mathematics, and to become familiar with its logical, yet intuitive, style of thinking.
sentences.zh: 因此,所有读者将有机会参与数学体验,欣赏数学之美,并熟悉其逻辑而直观的思维方式。

sentences.en: B. One of my purposes in writing this book is to give readers who haven’t had the opportunity to see and enjoy real mathematics the chance to appreciate the mathematical way of thinking.
sentences.zh: B. 我写这本书的目的之一是让那些没有机会看到和享受真正数学的读者有机会欣赏数学思维方式。

sentences.en: I want to reveal not only some of the fascinating discoveries, but, more importantly, the reasoning behind them.

sentences.en: In that respect, this book differs from most books on mathematics written for the general public.

sentences.en: Some present the lives of colorful mathematicians.

sentences.en: Yet others go into mathematical procedures but assume that the reader is adept in using algebra.

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: C. I hope this book will help bridge that notorious gap that separates the two cultures: the humanities and the sciences, or should I say the right brain (intuitive) and the left brain (analytical, numerical).
sentences.zh: C. 我希望这本书能够帮助弥合两种文化之间臭名昭著的鸿沟：人文和科学,或者我应该说右脑（直觉）和左脑（分析、数字）。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: As the chapters will illustrate, mathematics is not restricted to the analytical and numerical; intuition plays a significant role.
sentences.zh: 正如各章将说明的,数学并不局限于分析和数值；直觉起着重要作用。

sentences.en: The alleged gap can be narrowed or completely overcome by anyone, in part because each of us is far from using the full capacity of either side of the brain.

sentences.en: The reader must remain a tantalized spectator rather than an involved participant, since the appropriate language for describing the details in much of science is mathematics, whether the subject is expanding universe, subatomic particles, or chromosomes.

sentences.en: Though the broad outline of a scientific theory can be sketched intuitively, when a part of the physical universe is finally understood, its description often looks like a page in a mathematics text.
sentences.zh: 虽然科学理论的大致轮廓可以直观地勾勒出来,但当物理宇宙的一部分最终被理解时,它的描述往往看起来像数学文本中的一页。
